en.headline: 3 own commits plus 16 automated in sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu; 2 ideas started
en.summary: On 2026-10-13, sogeisetsu made **3 own commits** in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, plus 16 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. The own commits hardened the daily narrative pipeline: one test locked in that `generateNarrative` should not self-intercept on empty input, one fix removed a duplicate empty-gate in the AI layer and added regression cases, and one fix ensured blank days no longer swallow the discussion and other appended sections. No pull requests, reviews, issues, or releases were recorded. In `openchamber/openchamber`, the user started two Ideas discussions: #4823 "[Idea] Expose session context and usage stats to extensions via the SDK" and #4821 "[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel", both with 0 comments so far.
